ChatGPT Exporter integration

Source: https://github.com/huhusmang/ChatGPT-Exporter
Revision: c82dbb72dff97d8f13e48f77190af53577d5a400 (1.6.0)
chatgpt-exporter.js is the unmodified chrome-extension/exporter.user.js from that revision.
The upstream Tampermonkey.js header and package.json declare MIT licensing.
Author: huhu. Upstream credits Alex Mercer, Hanashiro and WenDavid for the original core.
Integration: loaded on demand from the Timeline Navigator popup; no reminder or updater service is included.
